sandbachFocus: Sandbach United produced a stunning upset this weekend, demolishing league leaders Wolverhampton Casuals 4-1 at home in what they described as their 'second win of the week.' Robbie Hatton opened the scoring from a corner after just four minutes, and though Casuals pulled one back through Liam Kirton, Sandbach secured the points with goals from Max Williams, Matthew Birchall, and Kieran Nolan. The Bach's second-half dominance was particularly impressive, with new signing Kieran Nolan proving a menace in attack despite his recent introduction to the lineup.
divisionWide: There was a significant shake-up at the top of the table, with Wolverhampton Casuals' surprise defeat potentially opening the door for other contenders. AFC Bridgnorth maintained their unbeaten record with a 3-2 victory at Alsager Town, with Sam Preece netting twice. Stafford Town recorded an emphatic 3-0 away win against struggling Crewe, moving them firmly into title contention. New Mills produced a dramatic comeback to beat Shawbury United 3-2 with two late goals from Cameron Tetlow and Luke Ferry. Eccleshall claimed a crucial 1-0 away victory at Foley Meir with Archie's 37th-minute strike. Cheadle Heath Nomads pulled off a stunning away result at Wednesfield Community, securing a 1-0 victory with a 90th-minute goal from Ewelike. At the bottom, Allscott Heath produced the weekend's most sensational performance, crushing bottom-club Widnes Town 7-0 with a five-goal second-half blitz. Telford Town drew 2-2 with Brereton Social in an entertaining encounter, while Bilston Town and Barnton shared the spoils in a 1-1 draw. In the local derby, Dawley Town defeated Market Drayton Town 3-1 to claim their first victory of the season.
